title: Gameweek Debrief: The Winners, Losers, and Underlying Stats
dek: De Cuyper led Gameweek 1 with 17 points. Underneath the scoreline, the expected-goals numbers tell a different story about who got lucky and who did not.
body:
## The headline

**De Cuyper** was the story of Gameweek 1: 17 points from 1 goal and 1 assist at home to AVL, in 77 minutes. He was owned by 3.5% of managers going into the round.

> The other side of the same weekend: **Thiago** (17.2% owned) returned 0, **Rogers** (24.3% owned) returned 1, **Calvert-Lewin** (30.3% owned) returned 1. Points you do not score are as expensive as points you do.

## The top scorers

| Player | Team | Pos | Pts | Mins | G | A | xGI | Owned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| De Cuyper | BHA | DEF | **17** | 77 | 1 | 1 | 1.68 | 3.5% |
| Hinshelwood | BHA | MID | **16** | 63 | 2 | 0 | 1.43 | 1.1% |
| Mendy | HUL | DEF | **15** | 63 | 1 | 0 | 0.28 | 1.7% |
| M.Sangaré | BRE | MID | **14** | 75 | 0 | 2 | 0.38 | 4.9% |
| Ajayi | HUL | DEF | **14** | 63 | 1 | 0 | 0.52 | 1.3% |

## Data against reality

**Gakpo** scored 1 from 0.3 expected goals — 0.7 more than the chances warranted. At the other end, **Isak** generated 1.09 expected goals and scored 0. That is the kind of return that tends to arrive late rather than never.

> One round is one round. These are descriptions of what happened in Gameweek 1, not verdicts on anybody's finishing. Ask again after five.

## The transfer blueprint

**Buy — De Cuyper** (BHA, £4.5m, 3.5% owned). 1.68 expected goal involvements in 77 minutes and still under-owned.

**Buy — Hinshelwood** (BHA, £6.0m, 1.1% owned). 1.43 expected goal involvements in 63 minutes and still under-owned.

**Hold — Haaland** (68.9% owned). 2 points reads badly, but 0.76 expected involvements says the process was fine. Selling here is selling the scoreline, not the player.

**Sell — James** (10.4% owned). 29 minutes. Minutes are the one thing no model can work around.

## The captaincy post-mortem

Of the widely-owned options, **Guéhi** returned 10 and **Thiago** returned 0. The armband was worth 10 points of swing between the two most obvious picks alone.
